履修条件
The qualification required for this class is completion of the master course in architecture and/or lighting engineering.
授業概要
昼光照明、電気照明、及び併用照明の設計法、屋内外の光環境・視環境の予測と評価の方法、建築空間に対する屋外気象の影響分析、建築空間の色彩調和論、光の生理的影響とそれに基づく屋内照明応用など、建築照明学における未知の問題、または問題解決のプロセスに関する研究。
Research work on unknown issues or processes of resolving problems in architectural lighting, involving various factors such as design methods of daylighting and electric lighting, methods of prediction and evaluation of luminous and visual environments indoor and outdoor, and non-visual effects of light on human beings.
